long_biography.plain_text:
The Sheikh Sultan bin Khalifa Al Nahyan Humanitarian and Scientific Foundation gives the Emirati royal's public work an institutional focus. It supports scientific research, health, education and humanitarian assistance, and has worked with the Emirates Red Crescent on programmes for communities in need.

His formation combined political and administrative sciences with military study at Zayed Military College and Sandhurst, followed by postgraduate work in political science, international studies and national security. He rose through military pilot and staff-officer ranks, becoming a staff colonel. Equestrian sport, Arabian-horse breeding and falconry form another sustained part of his public interests.
